DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされたイヤホンは一組ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左だけです。右と充電ケースはここにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片耳のみの紛失だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kaliwa lang. Nasa akin dito ang kanan at charging case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Linawing isang panig lang ang nawala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: なくした方を分かる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: May katangiang makakilala sa nawawalang panig?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白色で、内側にLとあります。ケースの製品番号も見せられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残るケースの番号と左右の特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Puti, may L sa loob. Maipapakita ko rin ang product number ng case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang numero ng natirang case at katangian ng kaliwa at kanan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に左を使った場所はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 公園のベンチです。ケースへ入れたと思いましたが、右だけ入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の使用と収納の経過を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa bangko ng parke. Akala ko nailagay sa case pero kanan lang ang nasa loob.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang huling paggamit at pagtatabi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチ周辺は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiningnan na ang paligid ng bangko?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻って足元を見ましたがありませんでした。端末の検索画面は古い位置なので、現在地とは断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 探索範囲と古い位置情報の限界を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bumalik ako at tumingin sa sahig pero wala. Lumang lokasyon ang nasa search screen, kaya hindi masasabing iyon ang kasalukuyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar na hinanap at limitasyon ng lumang lokasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した範囲と、位置情報の時刻も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatala rin ang saklaw na tiningnan at oras ng location information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 更新時刻は昨日六時です。左一個だけの届としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新時刻を示し片耳の届出を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Alas-sais kahapon ang update. Pakireport na isang kaliwa lang ang nawala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang update time at hilinging isang earpiece lang ang ulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。セットの残りが手元にあることも記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itatala ring hawak ninyo ang natitirang set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名の方はお客様ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kayo ba ang nakapangalan sa padadalhan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。隣の部屋の知人です。入院中で受け取りに来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入院中の知人宛てだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi. Kakilala sa katabing kuwarto. Nakaospital at hindi makapunta para kumuha.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na para sa kakilalang nakaospital. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様が代理で受け取るというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Gusto ninyong kumonsulta sa pagkuha bilang kinatawan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。本人から頼まれましたが、口頭のお願いだけで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口頭依頼で代理受取できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. Hiniling niya, pero sapat ba ang pasalitang hiling?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong kung pasalitang hiling ay sapat sa pagkuha bilang kinatawan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達物の種類と代理受取の条件を確認します。不在票を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang uri ng padala at kundisyon ng pagkuha. Patingin ng missed-delivery notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どうぞ。本人の身分証を勝手に持ち出すのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不在票を示し本人書類を無断利用しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Heto. Ayokong basta kunin ang kaniyang ID nang walang pahintulot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang notice at sabihing hindi gagamit ng ID nang walang pahintulot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な物と取れる方法は、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Matapos tiyakin, ipapaliwanag ang kailangan at magagawang paraan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。受取できない場合は、本人へ何を確認するか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不可時に本人へ聞く項目を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Kung hindi makuha, sabihin kung ano ang kailangang itanong sa kaniya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hingin ang kailangang itanong sa may-ari kung hindi puwede. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの連絡先で、本人から手続きの相談もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maaari rin siyang kumonsulta sa proseso gamit ang contact na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を伝えます。今日は条件がそろわなければ受け取らず、不在票を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人連絡を優先し未確認なら受取を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ibibigay ko ang contact. Kung kulang ang kundisyon ngayon, hindi ko kukunin at iuuwi ang notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unahin ang contact ng may-ari at ipagpaliban ang pagkuha kung di tiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず配達物の取扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Una, titiyakin ang patakaran sa padala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紛失したカードの停止は確認できています。再発行についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tiyak na ang pag-block sa nawalang card. Ipapaliwanag ang kapalit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。新しいカードはいつ、どう受け取りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再発行の時期と受取方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pakisuyo. Kailan at paano matatanggap ang bagong card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang oras at paraan ng pagtanggap ng kapalit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取方法とお届けの目安を、この案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan sa gabay ang paraan ng pagtanggap at tinatayang pagdating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日中は工場で働いています。郵便受けに入れてもらえる物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日中勤務と郵便受け配達の希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nagtatrabaho ako sa pabrika sa araw. Puwede bang ilagay sa mailbox?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang trabaho sa araw at hiling na mailbox delivery. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達の種類によって本人受取などの条件があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Depende sa uri ng delivery, may kundisyong personal na pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昼に受け取れない時の方法を、申請前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不在時の方法を申請前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bago mag-apply, gusto kong alamin ang paraan kung hindi makakatanggap sa araw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paraan kapag wala bago mag-apply. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在時の案内と受取先の条件をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang gabay kapag wala at kundisyon ng lugar ng pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受取先を会社に変えるだけで解決できるとは限らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社宛てへの任意変更で済まないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi pala laging malulutas sa pagpalit lang sa kumpanya ang address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyaking hindi basta maililipat sa kumpanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録住所との関係も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kailangan ding tingnan ang kaugnayan sa rehistradong address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務時間を伝えます。方法が分かってから、必要な書類で再発行を申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務条件を示し受取案内後に申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ibibigay ko ang oras ng trabaho. Kapag malinaw ang paraan, mag-aapply ng kapalit na may kailangang dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang kondisyon sa trabaho at mag-apply matapos gabay sa pagtanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様が受け取れる条件を順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Isa-isang titiyakin ang kundisyong matatanggap ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてお気付きの点があったそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May napansin daw kayo sa produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 開けた食品に小さい硬い物がありました。何かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不明な硬い物を断定せず報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: May maliit na matigas sa pagkaing binuksan. Hindi ko alam kung ano.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang di kilalang matigas na bagay nang hindi hinuhulaan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べたり取り除いたりしましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その部分は食べていません。中に入ったまま、ふたを閉じてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食べず中に残した状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko kinain ang bahaging iyon. Nasa loob pa at isinara ko ang takip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi kinain at naiwan sa loob. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。包装と購入情報は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng kawani. Nasa inyo pa ang balot at impormasyon ng pagbili?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残っています。破片だけ取り出して持って来た方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装保持と破片の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Mas mabuting ilabas ang piraso lang at dalhin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing may balot at itanong ang paghawak sa piraso. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は動かさず、状態を保って担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Huwag munang galawin, panatilihin ang kalagayan at hintayin ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。異物だと決めつけず、見た状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 動かさず観察した内容だけ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi ko agad tatawaging dayuhang bagay; sasabihin ang nakitang kalagayan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag galawin at sabihin lang ang naobserbahan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封の時刻と保管状況も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatanong din ang oras ng pagbukas at pag-iimbak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝八時に開け、表示どおり保管しました。商品と包装を残して確認に協力します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開封時刻と保管状況を示して確認に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Alas-otso kaninang umaga binuksan at inimbak ayon sa label. Itatabi ang produkto at balot at makikipagtulungan sa pagsusuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang oras ng pagbukas at imbakan at tumulong sa pagsusuri. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ状態と購入情報を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ipapasa sa kawani ang kalagayan at impormasyon ng pagbili.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の方へ下りようとされていますが、どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pababa kayo sa lawa, anong nangyari?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子が飛んで、あの斜面に落ちました。手が届きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 斜面へ落ちた帽子を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nilipad ang sombrero at nahulog sa dalisdis. Mukhang maaabot ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang sombrerong nahulog sa dalisdis. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 斜面は足を滑らせるおそれがあります。園路から離れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring madulas sa dalisdis. Huwag umalis sa daan ng parke.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで止まります。係員に取ってもらえるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立入らず係員の回収相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Dito ako titigil. Gusto kong itanong kung maikukuha ng kawani.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Huwag pumasok at ikonsulta ang pagkuha ng kawani. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を確認します。帽子の色と落ちた辺りを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang lugar. Sabihin ang kulay at kung saan nahulog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤い帽子で、二本目の木の下です。今は水には入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と位置と水に入っていない状態を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pulang sombrero sa ilalim ng ikalawang puno. Hindi pa nasa tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang kulay, posisyon, at hindi pa nasa tubig. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理担当へ知らせます。必ず回収できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sasabihin sa management. Hindi garantisadong makukuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。取れるまで下で待つのではなく、園路のベンチへ移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保証なしを理解し園路で待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Hindi ako maghihintay sa ibaba hanggang makuha; lilipat ako sa bangko sa daan ng parke.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unawaing walang garantiya at magpasiyang maghintay sa daan ng parke. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡できるよう管理棟にお名前をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabihin ang pangalan sa administration building para makontak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理棟へ行きます。自分で枝を伸ばして取るのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を伝え自力回収を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pupunta ako roon. Hindi ko rin susubukang abutin gamit ang sanga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magbigay ng contact at iwasang kunin mag-isa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。担当が安全を確認して対応をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Pakisuyo. Titiyakin ang kaligtasan bago ipaliwanag ang gagawin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の変更についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol sa pagbabago ng tiket, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。三人分買いましたが、一人来られなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数減少による不要券を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Bumili ako para sa tatlo, pero hindi na makakadating ang isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta sa sobrang tiket dahil bumaba ang bilang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使わない券と、使う予定の券を分けて見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ipakita nang hiwalay ang hindi gagamitin at gagamitin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一枚が不要です。まだどれも改札に入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用の一枚を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito ang hindi kailangan. Wala pa ni isa ang naipasok sa ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang isang di ginamit na tiket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券種と条件を確認して、変更や払い戻しをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang uri at kondisyon bago ipaliwanag ang pagbabago o refund.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に渡せばよいかとも思いましたが、名義や条件があるので先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人へ渡す前に券条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naisip kong ibigay sa kaibigan pero may pangalan at kondisyon kaya magtatanong muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang kundisyon bago ibigay sa iba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認も含め、この券の条件をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kasama ang pagtiyak na iyon, ipapaliwanag ang kondisyon nitong tiket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。使う二枚まで取り消さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使う二枚を取消対象外と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Huwag makansela pati ang dalawang gagamitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Linawing hindi kasali sa kanselasyon ang dalawang gagamitin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この一枚だけを対象に確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚は予定どおり使います。不要分の費用が分かったら手続きを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不要分の費用を聞いて手続きを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Gagamitin ang dalawa ayon sa plano. Kapag alam ang gastos ng sobrang isa, pipiliin ko ang proseso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Alamin ang gastos sa sobrang tiket bago magpasya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。変更の条件と金額をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ipapaliwanag ang kondisyon at halaga ng pagbabago.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの用紙についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol sa form na ito ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。これを返せば、案内のサービスに申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返送紙でサービス申込できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Kung ibabalik ito, makaka-apply sa serbisyong nasa gabay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung pagbalik ng papel ay aplikasyon sa serbisyo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙はアンケートです。サービスの申請とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Questionnaire ito. Hiwalay sa aplikasyon ng serbisyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 希望する所に丸を付けても、利用申込みにはならないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望欄でも申込にならないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa rin aplikasyon kahit bilugan ang gustong bahagi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi aplikasyon ang preference section. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。申請用の案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Ito ang gabay sa pag-apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: アンケートを出すかどうかと、利用の申込みを別々に考えます。必要な書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: アンケートと申請を分け必要書類を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hiwalay kong iisipin kung magpapasa ng questionnaire at mag-aapply ng serbisyo. Sabihin ang kailangang dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay questionnaire at aplikasyon at itanong ang dokumento. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請の条件と確認資料をこの一覧でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan sa listahan ang kundisyon at mga katibayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は足りない物があります。先にアンケートだけ出しても申請済みとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足資料と未申請状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: May kulang ako ngayon. Kahit questionnaire lang muna ang ipasa, hindi ko iisiping nag-apply na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kulang at hindi pa nag-apply. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請の受付完了は、提出後に別途ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tiyakin nang hiwalay ang pagtanggap ng aplikasyon matapos magpasa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料をそろえて来ます。サービスを使える日も、申請しただけで決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料準備後の受付と利用開始を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kukumpletuhin ko at babalik. Hindi ko rin itatakda ang araw ng paggamit dahil lang nakapag-apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihanda ang dokumento at tiyakin ang pagtanggap at simula ng paggamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用開始の案内も申請時にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Tiyakin din ang gabay ng pagsisimula sa pag-apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票に未記入の欄がありますが、書きにくい所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May blangko sa medical questionnaire, mahirap bang sulatan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。妊娠の可能性の欄です。ここでは人に聞こえるので話しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私的な問診欄を人前で話せないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo, ang posibilidad ng pagbubuntis. Mahirap pag-usapan dito dahil naririnig ng iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi mapag-usapan sa publiko ang pribadong bahagi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 看護師へ別の場所で相談する希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ipapaalam sa nurse na gustong kumonsulta sa ibang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。分からないまま「ない」に丸を付けたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不確定な回答を記入しない意向を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pakisuyo. Ayokong bilugan ang 'wala' nang hindi alam.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing ayaw magsulat ng di tiyak na sagot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で確定できない内容は、そのまま担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabihin nang tapat sa kawani ang hindi matiyak mag-isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「可能性は分からないので確認したい」と伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 看護師に伝える内容を明確に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Maipapasabi bang 'hindi ko alam kung may posibilidad at gusto kong tiyakin'?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Malinaw na hilingin ang mensahe sa nurse. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ほかの方に聞こえない説明方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Titiyakin ding may paraang hindi maririnig ng iba.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。問診票は伏せて手元に置き、看護師に直接渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問診票を伏せ直接渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Salamat. Itataob ko ang questionnaire sa akin at direktang ibibigay sa nurse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang itaob ang papel at ibigay nang direkta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がご案内しますので、ここでお待ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。診察や検査の前に、看護師へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察前に個別説明を受けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Kakausapin ang nurse bago konsultasyon o pagsusuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyaking may pribadong paliwanag bago konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その希望を引き継ぎます。ご案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa ang hiling. Maghintay sa paggabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらで鍵を拾われましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は拾っていません。公園にいた人から、警察へ届けてほしいと頼まれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は拾得者でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi ako ang nakapulot. May tao sa parke na nakiusap na dalhin ko sa pulis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi kayo ang nakapulot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方は拾った場所を話していましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sinabi ba niya kung saan napulot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 北のベンチと言っていました。私はその場を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾得場所は伝聞だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sabi niya sa north bench. Hindi ko nakita ang lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay na narinig lang ang lugar ng pagkakapulot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 預かった時刻と場所は、ご自身で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Alam ninyo mismo ang oras at lugar ng pagtanggap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日三時、公園の入口です。相手の名前は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際に預かった時刻と場所を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Alas-tres ngayon, sa pasukan ng parke. Hindi ko tinanong ang pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang tunay na oras at lugar ng pagtanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 直接確認したことと、聞いたことを分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatala nang hiwalay ang direktang natiyak at narinig.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私が北のベンチで拾ったと書かれないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直接拾った記録にならないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Huwag isulat na ako ang nakapulot sa north bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging hindi itala na kayo ang direktang nakapulot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵を預かった後は、何か取り外しましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのままです。輪に三本付いています。預かった入口からここまで直接来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預かり後の無変更と移動を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Wala, ganoon pa rin. Tatlong susi sa singsing. Diretso ako rito mula sa pasukan kung saan tinanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang binago at ang biyahe matapos tanggapin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。引継ぎの経緯として伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itatala bilang pangyayari ng pag-abot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所が変わるご予定ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三週間帰国します。戻ったら同じ部屋に住むので、住所は変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ住居に戻る一時帰国だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Uuwi ako sa sariling bansa nang tatlong linggo. Parehong kuwarto pagbalik, kaya hindi magbabago ang address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pansamantalang pag-uwi at pagbabalik sa parehong bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では転居ではなく、不在中の郵便のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi pala paglipat kundi koreo habang wala ang usapan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。転居届を書きかけましたが、海外へ転送したいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 海外転送でなく不在管理を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. Nagsimula akong sumulat ng moving notice pero hindi ko gustong ipadala sa ibang bansa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hilingin ang pag-aasikaso habang wala at hindi overseas forwarding. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不在の期間と郵便の種類に応じて、ご案内する方法が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Iba ang paraang ipapaliwanag ayon sa tagal ng pagkawala at uri ng koreo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発は十日、帰りは三十日です。郵便受けにたまるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発帰宅日と郵便の滞留を懸念する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Aalis sa a-diyes at babalik sa a-trenta. Nag-aalala akong mapuno ang mailbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang araw ng alis at balik at pag-aalala sa naipong sulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご利用できる保管などの条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itatanong sa kawani ang kundisyon ng maaaring itago at ibang opsiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。保管できない物があるなら、差出人にも出発前に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象外郵便は差出人対応も検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Kung may hindi maitatago, kokontakin ko rin ang sender bago umalis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Isaalang-alang ang sender para sa koreong hindi sakop. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象と期間の案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ibibigay ang gabay sa sakop at panahon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を確認し、一時不在として相談します。転居届は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転居でなく一時不在の方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Babasa ako at kukonsulta bilang pansamantalang pagkawala. Hindi magpapasa ng moving notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang pansamantalang pagkawala sa halip na paglipat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご利用の条件が合うか順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Isa-isang titiyakin kung tugma ang kundisyon ng paggamit.
